newsitem.title: USA: Genetics Institute, Genset set proteins alliance.
newsitem.headline: Genetics Institute, Genset set proteins alliance.

text.p: Genetics Institute Inc said Monday Genset will provide, on an exclusive basis, full-length genes encoding novel human secreted proteins from its SignalTag library for expression and inclusion in Genetics Institute's DiscoverEase protein development platform.

Under this license agreement, the combined protein library from two of the world's secreted protein technology leaders will be offered to all existing and potential participants in Genetics Institute's DiscoverEase program, the American Home Products Corp subsidiary said.
It said Genset will receive payments based on the number of novel SignalTag secreted protein cDNAs included in the DiscoverEase platform and delivered to DiscoverEase program participants.

These payments could total up to $20 million if 2,000 Genset clones are delivered to GI and ordered by a certain number of DiscoverEase participants. In addition, Genset will receive option fees, license fees, milestones and royalty payments for all products developed by GI or DiscoverEase participants using SignalTag proteins.

Further terms of the agreement were not disclosed, Genetics Institute said. The agreement is subject to a number of conditions precedent, including review and clearance under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act.
